tagline.en: Ocean City to Sacramento, and the Loneliest Road between
tagline.zh: 自大洋城至萨克拉门托，途经「最孤独的路」

start.zh: 加利福尼亚州西萨克拉门托

end.en: Ocean City, Maryland, on the Atlantic
end.zh: 马里兰州大洋城，大西洋岸

en: US 50 crosses the country roughly through its middle and changes register about as often as any road can. It starts on the Maryland beach at Ocean City, runs up the Eastern Shore and over the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, becomes a freeway into Washington, and leaves the capital as a working east–west road through Virginia, West Virginia, Ohio and Indiana — Clarksburg, Parkersburg, Cincinnati, Vincennes — to St. Louis and Kansas City.

West of Kansas City it turns into a plains highway along the Arkansas River, through Dodge City and Garden City and into Colorado at Lamar. From Pueblo it follows the Arkansas up into the mountains past the Royal Gorge and Salida, crosses the Continental Divide at Monarch Pass, and runs through Gunnison and Montrose to Grand Junction.

Then Utah and Nevada, which is the part people photograph: across the San Rafael Swell, over the Great Basin's north–south ranges one after another — Ely, Eureka, Austin, Fallon — before climbing the Sierra at Echo Summit, dropping past Lake Tahoe and ending in the Sacramento Valley.
zh: US 50 大致自国土中部横贯东西，其性格变化之频繁，在公路中数一数二。它起于马里兰州大洋城的海滩，沿东岸半岛北上，跨切萨皮克湾大桥，化作通往华盛顿的高速公路；离开首都后，又成为一条实用的东西向道路，穿过弗吉尼亚、西弗吉尼亚、俄亥俄与印第安纳——克拉克斯堡、帕克斯堡、辛辛那提、文森——直抵圣路易斯与堪萨斯城。
堪萨斯城以西，它变成沿阿肯色河而行的平原公路，经道奇城与加登城，在拉马尔进入科罗拉多。自普韦布洛起，它顺阿肯色河上行入山，经皇家峡谷与萨利达，在莫纳克山口翻越大陆分水岭，再经冈尼森与蒙特罗斯抵达大章克申。
接下来是犹他与内华达，也就是人们拍照最多的那一段：横穿圣拉斐尔隆起，再一座接一座翻越大盆地的南北向山脉——伊利、尤里卡、奥斯汀、福伦——随后在回声垭爬上内华达山脉，经太浩湖下坡，终于萨克拉门托谷地。

en: The Joint Board's 1925 draft ran US 50 from Wadsworth, Nevada, east to Annapolis, along parts of the Lincoln Highway, the Midland Trail and the National Old Trails Road. The version approved on 11 November 1926 reached Sacramento, but there was no usable road across western Utah, so the route was bent north through Salt Lake City; it was put onto the direct Great Basin line — the corridor it shares with US 6 — only in the 1950s.

Both ends have moved. In the early 1930s US 50 was extended from Sacramento through Stockton to the San Francisco Bay Area, replacing US 48; California's 1964 renumbering gave that section to I-580 and cut US 50 back to Sacramento. At the other end, the route was pushed east from Annapolis to Ocean City in 1949, taking over MD 404 and US 213 on the Eastern Shore. For its first three years that extension depended on the Sandy Point–Matapeake ferry; the Chesapeake Bay Bridge replaced it in 1952.
zh: 联合委员会 1925 年的草案让 US 50 自内华达州沃兹沃思东行至安纳波利斯，沿途借用林肯公路、米德兰小道与全国古道的部分路段。1926 年 11 月 11 日通过的版本西端抵达萨克拉门托，但犹他州西部当时没有可用道路，于是线位北折经盐湖城绕行；直到 1950 年代，它才被移到横穿大盆地的直线走廊上，也就是它与 US 6 共用的那条通道。
两端都挪动过。1930 年代初，US 50 自萨克拉门托经斯托克顿延伸至旧金山湾区，取代 US 48；加州 1964 年重新编号把那一段划给 I-580，US 50 被收回至萨克拉门托。另一端则于 1949 年自安纳波利斯东延至大洋城，接收了东岸半岛上的 MD 404 与 US 213。延伸段最初三年依赖桑迪角—马塔皮克渡轮；1952 年切萨皮克湾大桥建成取而代之。

en: In July 1986 Life magazine ran a page of American superlatives and gave US 50 across Nevada the title of loneliest road, quoting an unnamed AAA counsellor: "It's totally empty. There are no points of interest. We don't recommend it. We warn all motorists not to drive there unless they're confident of their survival skills." The stretch it meant was the 287 miles between Ely and Fernley.

Nevada decided not to argue. The state tourism commission and the chambers of commerce of the towns on the line — Fernley, Fallon, Austin, Eureka and Ely — put out a Highway 50 Survival Guide the same month, with a passport to be stamped in each town and mailed in for a certificate signed by the governor. It worked well enough that the legislature authorised official "Loneliest Road in America" signs, and the name is now used in Nevada's own highway logs.
zh: 1986 年 7 月，《生活》杂志刊出一页「美国之最」，把内华达州境内的 US 50 评为最孤独的路，并引述一位未具名的美国汽车协会顾问的话：「那里完全是空的。没有任何景点。我们不推荐。我们警告所有驾车者，除非对自己的生存技能有把握，否则不要开去那里。」文中所指的，是伊利与弗恩利之间的 287 英里。
内华达决定不作辩解。州旅游委员会与沿线各镇——弗恩利、福伦、奥斯汀、尤里卡与伊利——的商会在同月推出《50 号公路生存指南》，附一本需在各镇盖章的护照，集齐后寄回可换取一张由州长签名的证书。效果好到州议会批准设立正式的「全美最孤独之路」标志牌，如今该名称已用于内华达州自己的公路路线记录。

why.en: No figure exists. US 50 was numbered in 1926 over auto trails and state roads already in use, and has been rebuilt piecemeal by twelve states since; only individual projects such as the Chesapeake Bay Bridge were costed as works of their own.
why.zh: 没有这样的数据。US 50 于 1926 年沿已在使用的命名汽车道与州级道路编号，此后由 12 个州分段陆续改建；只有切萨皮克湾大桥一类单项工程留有独立造价。

why.en: No authoritative current figure exists. AASHTO leaves U.S. Route mileage to the states and last published a national log in 1989; US 50's western end was cut back in 1964 and its Utah routing rebuilt in the 1950s.
why.zh: 目前没有权威数据。AASHTO 把美国国道里程交由各州统计，最后一份全国里程表发布于 1989 年；US 50 的西端于 1964 年被截短，犹他段线位在 1950 年代重建。

label.en: Distance posted at the eastern terminus

value.en: The sign at the Ocean City end of US 50 gives the distance to Sacramento as 3,073 miles
value.zh: US 50 大洋城端的标志牌标示至萨克拉门托为 3,073 英里

figures.source: MDRoads, route history and terminus photographs for US 50

value.en: Life magazine applied the name in July 1986 to the 287 miles of US 50 between Ely and Fernley, Nevada
value.zh: 1986 年 7 月，《生活》杂志把这一名称用于内华达州伊利与弗恩利之间的 287 英里 US 50 路段

trafficFigures.source: Life, July 1986, as reported by the Los Angeles Times, 25 August 1986

why.en: Twelve state agencies count US 50 separately. The route carries Washington commuter traffic on a freeway at one end and crosses Nevada basins where a driver may pass no one for an hour at the other; no combined figure is published.
why.zh: 12 个州的机构各自统计 US 50。这条路一端是承担华盛顿通勤车流的高速公路，另一端横穿内华达盆地、可能一小时不见来车；并无合并统计数字发布。

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class, not by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating for US 50 exists.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级上报联邦公路管理局，而非按美国国道编号上报，因此不存在针对 US 50 的全线评级。

timeline.en: US 50 is approved on 11 November, from Sacramento to Annapolis, detouring north through Salt Lake City for want of a road across western Utah.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日 US 50 获批，自萨克拉门托至安纳波利斯；因犹他州西部无路可走，线位北折绕经盐湖城。

timeline.en: The eastern end is extended from Annapolis across the Chesapeake by ferry to Ocean City.
timeline.zh: 东端自安纳波利斯经渡轮跨切萨皮克湾延伸至大洋城。

timeline.en: The Chesapeake Bay Bridge opens and replaces the Sandy Point–Matapeake ferry.
timeline.zh: 切萨皮克湾大桥通车，取代桑迪角—马塔皮克渡轮。

timeline.en: California's renumbering cuts US 50 back from the Bay Area to Sacramento.
timeline.zh: 加州重新编号，把 US 50 自湾区收回至萨克拉门托。

timeline.en: Life magazine names the Nevada section the Loneliest Road in America; the state adopts the phrase as a slogan.
timeline.zh: 《生活》杂志把内华达段称为「全美最孤独之路」，该州随即把这句话用作宣传口号。
